source_verdict_matrix.source: Chudnovsky–Spirkl–Zhong, Four-Coloring P6-Free Graphs II: Finding an Excellent Precoloring
source_verdict_matrix.imported_fact: For P6-free 4-precoloring, bounded-seed guessing plus normal-subcase transformations yields a polynomial-sized equivalent collection of excellent starred precolorings.
source_verdict_matrix.exact_mismatch: The normalization proofs repeatedly use the exclusion of an induced P6. Paper-II Lemma 11 itself derives z-y-s-p-m-n as an induced P6 contradiction, and later axioms/lemmas contain further induced-P6 contradictions. P7-free graphs may contain induced P6.
source_verdict_matrix.consequence_for_A: Useful methodology for semantic-equivalent bounded-state reduction, but not directly importable as a P7/C11 theorem.
source_verdict_matrix.consequence_for_B: Replacing Lemma 11 alone is insufficient to inherit Paper II.

source_verdict_matrix.source: Chudnovsky–Spirkl–Zhong, Four-Coloring P6-Free Graphs I: Extending an Excellent Precoloring
source_verdict_matrix.imported_fact: Polynomial solver for excellent starred precolorings with bounded seed in P6-free graphs.
source_verdict_matrix.exact_mismatch: Core companion/orthogonality machinery also repeatedly obtains contradictions by producing induced P6s; therefore even an excellent-precoloring reduction does not automatically transfer to P7-free C11 objects.
source_verdict_matrix.consequence_for_B: A genuine lift needs a package of C11-specific replacements for multiple P6-dependent proof obligations, not a single Lemma-11 patch.

source_verdict_matrix.source: Bonomo, Chudnovsky, Maceli, Schaudt, Stein, Zhong, Three-coloring and list three-coloring of graphs without induced paths on seven vertices
source_verdict_matrix.imported_fact: List 3-Coloring is polynomial on P7-free graphs when every list is a subset of one fixed 3-color palette. The algorithm uses a small connected 2-dominating seed, controlled enumeration, and reduction to instances with lists of size at most 2, then a 2-SAT-type terminal.
source_verdict_matrix.exact_use_for_C11: If a bounded C11 boundary assignment produces a residual with one globally absent color, the resulting P7-free instance can enter this terminal without inventing a new coloring solver.
source_verdict_matrix.firewall: Per-vertex list size <=3 with union of four colors is not the same premise as List 3-Coloring over a fixed three-color palette.

source_verdict_matrix.source: Camby–Schaudt, A New Characterization of P_k-free Graphs
source_verdict_matrix.imported_fact: Every connected P_k-free graph has a connected dominating set whose induced graph is P_{k-2}-free or P_{k-2}; for P7-free List-3 this yields a connected 2-dominating set of size at most 3 or K4.
source_verdict_matrix.exact_mismatch_for_B: This controls domination structure but does not forbid induced P6, so it does not replace the P6 contradictions used in Paper I/II.

source_verdict_matrix.source: Broersma–Golovach–Paulusma–Song, Updating the complexity status of coloring graphs without a fixed induced linear forest
source_verdict_matrix.contradicts: Any candidate claiming a polynomial algorithm for unrestricted P7-free 4-Precoloring Extension.
source_verdict_matrix.fact: 4-Precoloring Extension is NP-complete on P7-free graphs.
source_verdict_matrix.firewall: Does not block a polynomial algorithm for a narrower C11/PI subclass using additional structure.

source_verdict_matrix.source: Huang, Improved complexity results on k-coloring P_t-free graphs
source_verdict_matrix.contradicts: Any candidate that silently generalizes the C11 route to arbitrary P7-free 4-Coloring.

source_verdict_matrix.source: Golovach–Paulusma–Song, Closing complexity gaps for coloring problems on H-free graphs
source_verdict_matrix.contradicts: Using unrestricted List 4-Coloring as a generic terminal after C11 state compression.
source_verdict_matrix.fact: List 4-Coloring is NP-complete already on P6-free graphs.
source_verdict_matrix.implication: A useful C11 quotient must preserve stronger precoloring/C11 structure or route to narrower known terminals rather than arbitrary 4-list instances.

source_verdict_matrix.source: Grzesik–Klimošová–Pilipczuk–Pilipczuk, Covering minimal separators and potential maximal cliques in P_t-free graphs
source_verdict_matrix.imported_fact: For every minimal separator S in a P7-free graph there is S' of size at most 22 with S contained in the closed neighborhood N[S'].
source_verdict_matrix.firewall: Neighborhood-cover size is not separator cardinality and does not imply bounded vertex connectivity or a bounded C11 interface.

source_verdict_matrix.source: Lozin–Zamaraev, The structure and the number of P7-free bipartite graphs
source_verdict_matrix.imported_fact: P7-free bipartite graphs admit the published recursive chain-decomposition structure.
source_verdict_matrix.conditional_use: Import only after the derived graph is independently verified bipartite and P7-free.
source_verdict_matrix.firewall: A quotient/channel graph formed by deleting edges or changing representation is not automatically an induced P7-free subgraph.

source_verdict_matrix.source: Brettell–Horsfield–Munaro–Paulusma, List k-Colouring P_t-Free Graphs: a Mim-width Perspective
source_verdict_matrix.imported_fact: For fixed k,s,t, List k-Coloring is polynomial on (K_{1,s}^1,P_t)-free graphs through bounded quickly-computable mim-width.
source_verdict_matrix.exact_mismatch: No source located showing that C11 PI residuals after fixing (y,y') exclude a fixed induced 1-subdivision K_{1,s}^1 or otherwise have bounded quickly-computable mim-width.

source_verdict_matrix.source: Chudnovsky–Czyżewska–Kluk–Pilipczuk–Rzążewski, Sparse Induced Subgraphs in P7-Free Graphs of Bounded Clique Number
source_verdict_matrix.imported_fact: A broad CMSO2 sparse-induced-subgraph framework becomes polynomial for P7-free graphs of bounded clique number.
source_verdict_matrix.exact_mismatch: The solved object additionally requires a fixed bounded-treewidth/treedepth sparse induced target; it is not a generic 4-coloring/precoloring algorithm and therefore does not close P3 or Lemma11.

source_verdict_matrix.imported_fact: Strong modules and the canonical modular-decomposition tree/quotient are efficiently computable.
source_verdict_matrix.exact_mismatch: No located theorem identifies the C11 extension behavior under a fixed survivor pair with the modular quotient alone.

PATH_A_CANDIDATE.name: PI_EXACT_POLYNOMIAL_DISCOVERY
PATH_A_CANDIDATE.exact_missing_theorem_or_lemma: A C11-specific theorem that, after the bounded survivor-pair/boundary state is fixed, computes in polynomial time a polynomial-size family of exact extension-equivalent states/quotients, preserving satisfiability and reconstruction, and routes every state to an already justified polynomial terminal or a precisely declared unresolved class.
strongest_source_backed_structure: Paper-II methodology: bounded seed + polynomial equivalent collections + reconstruction.
P7-free List 3-Coloring terminal with small dominating seed and controlled state enumeration.
Width/representative-state frameworks when their extra hypotheses are separately proved.
PATH_A_CANDIDATE.exact_hypothesis_mismatch: No located source proves that fixing the C11 pair (y,y') forces a global missing color, bounded interface, bounded relevant width, exclusion of K_{1,s}^1, or a polynomial number of extension-distinct pair states.
potential_falsifiers: Two valid C11 residual states receive the same proposed quotient signature but have different extension truth values.
A source-valid C11 family forces superpolynomially many extension-distinct states for the proposed signature.
The proposed state class contains a known unrestricted P7-free hard family without an additional C11 restriction.
genuinely_unproved: Existence of a polynomial-size exact pair quotient.
Polynomial graph/list/boundary-only computability without an extension oracle.
Completeness of routing to known polynomial terminals.

PATH_B_CANDIDATE.name: DIRECT_LEMMA11_P7_REPLACEMENT
PATH_B_CANDIDATE.exact_missing_theorem_or_lemma: Not merely Paper-II Lemma 11. A complete C11-specific replacement package is required for the multiple P6-exclusion arguments used in Paper II normalization and in Paper I's excellent-precoloring solver.
strongest_source_backed_structure: P7-free bipartite chain decomposition under independent bipartite/P7 checks.
PATH_B_CANDIDATE.exact_hypothesis_mismatch: All located P7 structural results permit induced P6s. None is a source-backed substitute for every place where the CSZ proofs infer a contradiction from an induced P6.
PATH_B_CANDIDATE.known_hardness_barrier: Any replacement package stated for arbitrary P7-free 4-precoloring would contradict known NP-completeness; it must use additional C11 hypotheses.
potential_falsifiers: A C11-valid seeded configuration satisfies the pre-Lemma-11 axioms but violates axiom (vi) while remaining P7-free.
Any later Paper-I/II P6-dependent proof obligation admits a C11-valid counterconfiguration even if Lemma 11 itself is repaired.
genuinely_unproved: Whether C11 premises kill the exact Lemma-11 bad configuration.
Whether every downstream P6-dependent normalization lemma has a C11 replacement.
Whether Paper-I companion/orthogonality lemmas remain valid under the same replacements.
Whether the resulting package stays polynomial and reconstruction-safe.
